    - Mind the scaffold. I climb every one myself before a mason sets foot on it. If it holds me, it holds anyone.

    - Dorrek, chieftain of the Kragvar these eleven years, since my uncle Baruk died in the rockfall on the old north stair. I dug all that night. My father Ulm kept the fire.
